icons.prompt: Restyle the attached existing character image into ONE square painted RPG origin-of-power icon. Treat the attached image as the edit target and preserve that SAME character's recognizable face, hairstyle, clothing colors, expression, orientation and signature accessories. Adapt the existing pose into a readable chest-up or waist-up portrait suitable for a square icon. Use a restrained hand-painted style with very few details, broad opaque color planes, simple light and shadow, a limited muted palette and sparse soft brushwork. No fine hair strands, no ornate texture, no glossy 3D rendering, no sharp anime ink outlines. Keep the face large and clear at small icon sizes. Isolated cutout on a truly transparent background, softly painted lower edge. No scenery, background rectangle, border, text or logo. Intended final asset is 512 x 512 WebP. Do not replace the character with someone else or add new costume elements. This origin is Receptáculo, represented by Yuji Itadori: keep his short spiky pink hair, serious forward gaze and dark zipped hooded outfit with the red toggles visible in the reference. Retain the reference outfit rather than substituting another outfit.

Preserve image 1's entire existing illustration: same face, expression, existing forehead scar, eyes, pink hairstyle, charcoal hooded outfit, red toggles, pose, framing, simple broad painted color planes and transparent background.
